reference_text: Hello everyone, this is, this is Joe Biden. I want to wish you all Happy New Year. I know this is the time of year when we make resolutions to take care of our health, whether it's joining a gym or eating healthier.
reference_note: Text where YouTube's captions and an independent verbatim Whisper pass agree. Not hand-verified, so word timings are not used from this sample.
